title: Weaver residual review session — residuals.json
description: T-RS1-3. Written by pack.py (via triage.py's build_residuals), read by the bound Copilot Chat agent (T-RS1-5) and, once built, draft_tier_b.py (T-RS4-1). MVP scope: derived from review-queue.json's own triggers (S1/S2/S5/low-architecture-coverage) — unmapped-signal-cluster catalogue_candidate promotion and generic ontology-conflict detection beyond S5 are named, real, separate extensions to this schema (real classes may be appended later; existing fields do not change shape).

id.description: Stable within one Session Pack; not reused across packs.

tier.description: A = architect must decide (choice card). B = LLM may draft if evidence bar met (RS-4, not yet built — every Tier B item is treated as Tier A until then). C = do not invent; document OOS or leave open.

class.description: One of Architect_Residual_Review_Session.md §3's taxonomy classes, e.g. multi-candidate-bridge, security-authority-policy, ontology-judgment, missing-intermediates-not-in-scan. Not a closed enum in this schema — new trigger->class mappings are additive in triage.py, same discipline as signal-catalogue.yml.

trigger.description: The originating review-queue.json trigger (or, for future non-review-queue sources like unmapped clusters, a distinct source tag) — always traceable to a real, computed signal, never invented.

unitIds.description: Empty for a genuinely run-level residual (e.g. S5-cfn-routes-found-but-unbound) — by definition no unit was matched, so none can be named. Never fabricated to fill this field.

evidenceRefs.description: file:line refs, each expected to have a corresponding redacted snippet in evidence/packs.json.

status.description: MVP only ever writes 'open' — 'drafted'/'applied'/'carried_forward' are set by later phases (RS-2 validate_drafts, RS-3 apply, RS-3 --baseline), named here so the schema doesn't need to change shape when those land.
